Title: General availability: Azure mobile app now supports Azure Government

Body.Content:
Now available for Azure Government subscriptions, the Azure mobile app enables you to manage your Azure environment from the convenience of your phone. It helps enhance your productivity with easy monitoring of your resources, quick diagnose and fix issues, as well as leveraging Azure alerts.

In addition, the Azure mobile app give you access to Cloud Shell to leverage to full power of Azure.

Try it today.
